judge_boundary: The candidate never receives this file or its path.

checks.pass: Candidate access receipt contains exactly the arm packet inputs and no hidden evaluator or legacy path.
Candidate records the frozen protocol digest and preserves the paired design, test seal, estimand, uncertainty, and evidence classes.
Strict manifest probing and the packaged AdaOS skill tests pass through native CLI commands.
Conditions, execution lifecycle, tracker records, and evidence surfaces pass the frozen conformance fixture.
A real three-epoch CPU paired smoke completes for seed 17 and is classified only as workflow evidence.
An independent verifier reconstructs content identities and rejects smoke records as confirmatory evidence.

exclusions: Only a preregistered platform outage before candidate execution may exclude an attempt.
Model refusal, timeout after candidate execution begins, schema failure, protocol drift, and implementation or evidence failure remain scored failures of the primary correctness endpoint.
Resource budget excess is never excluded and is recorded only by budget_compliant and the budgeted secondary endpoint.
